name: modal
title: Modal
description: A modal dialog component built on Radix UI Dialog with overlay, header, body, and footer sections. Uses namespace exports: Modal.Root, Modal.Trigger, Modal.Content, Modal.Header, Modal.Body, Modal.Footer, Modal.Close.

docs.lead: A modal dialog component with overlay backdrop, optional header with icon, body, and footer sections.

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Simple modal with body content, icon, and footer actions.

examples.title: With Header
examples.description: Modal with a header section containing icon, title, and description.
examples.code:
<Modal.Content>
  <Modal.Header
    icon={RiChatSettingsLine}
    title="Communication Preferences"
    description="Choose contact preferences."
  />
  <Modal.Body>...</Modal.Body>
  <Modal.Footer>...</Modal.Footer>
</Modal.Content>

api.name: Modal.Root
api.description: Wraps the trigger and content. Passes through Radix Dialog.Root props.

api.name: Modal.Trigger
api.description: The element that opens the modal.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Modal.Content
api.description: The modal popup with overlay and close button.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the close button in the top-right corner

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the overlay backdrop

api.name: Modal.Header
api.description: Optional header with icon, title, and description. Renders children directly if provided.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component displayed in a circular container

api.name: Modal.Body
api.description: The main content area with padding.
